scene: Arlequino gives a theatrical bow after the Asturias-assisted training, then leaves the western training field carrying the guitar and walks to the palace. He reaches the outer palace gate. No automatic access is granted: Arlequino has no confirmed appointment with Carrion. Palace guards stop him at the controlled entrance and ask his name and business. Borga remains at training; Rena remains independently away on organizer search unless later observed otherwise.
